mainText: Good morning. Markets are rallying sharply this morning. Dow futures are up one point nine percent, the S and P 500 up two point four percent, and the Nasdaq up three point one percent, a sharp rebound after last week's AI selloff pushed the S and P and the Dow into correction. The ten year Treasury yield is four point nine six percent, up about five basis points from Friday's close near four point nine one percent. Biggest premarket movers: Nvidia up eight and a half percent on the AI bounce. Zscaler up thirteen percent after CrowdStrike announced a forty three point nine billion dollar acquisition. CrowdStrike down eight percent as the acquirer. Capricor down seventy one percent on a trial setback. And DataMeds AI up fifty five percent on AI integration news.
